forms.label: ている past polite

definitions.gloss: to be found; to be noticed; to be seen
definitions.explanation: To come into view or to be found when looking. Often used in the negative (見当たらない) to mean something cannot be found.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見当|みあ}たらない。
⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧な⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見当|みあ}たらない。
examples.english: No suitable candidate can be found.

examples.japanese: ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見当|みあ}たらなかった。
examples.english: No matter where I looked, I couldn't find my wallet.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly used in the negative form {見当|みあ}たらない (cannot be found). The affirmative form is less frequent but does occur. This is an intransitive verb — the thing being found is the subject.

WRITING:
Also written as {見|み}あたる in kana, or {見当|みあ}たる as a single unit. Despite the kanji ⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧, this is a distinct word from ⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to hit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見当|みあ}たらない (cannot be found)
- ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{見当|みあ}たらない (nowhere to be found)
- ⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見当|みあ}たらない (no particular problems can be found)
